topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

II. It is not expected to be able to continue further
III. It is expected to continue in operational existence for a foreseeable future
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

e: Correct answer: P1 (from the IC46 question bank).

o: Fair value subject to impairment provisions
Historical cost subject to impairment provisions
e: Correct answer: Historical cost subject to impairment provisions (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following accounting treatment is correct?

III. GR purchased a motor car for Rs. 3,40,000 on 15 Feb 2012. The accountant has charged depreciation for one and half months at the rates applicable
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

Selling rate of exchange the end of accounting per

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

III. Cheques issued, presented and cashed
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

Identify the main purpose of preparing Cash Flow Statement in a general insurance business.

I. To show a summary of income and expenditure
II. To determine the net profit or loss
III. To assess the ability of the company to generate cash and cash equivalent
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

To give the position of assets, liabilities and capital at a point of time
To obtain a valuation of the business
To create awareness among the shareholders
e: Correct answer: To give the position of assets, liabilities and capital at a point of time (from the IC46 question bank).

e: Correct answer: Rs. 600 (from the IC46 question bank).

AS 2 accounting for inventories applies to all inventories except:
